name: ai-visibility
title_zh: 不靠猜，直接读 GA4 原始流量，看 ChatGPT
tagline_zh: 别再问大模型‘你见过我吗’——那是幻觉。从 GA4 真实来源里扒出 ChatGPT、Perplexity。
tagline_en: Stop asking LLMs 'have you seen me?'—that's hallucination. Pull real ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini.
desc_en: Measure real AI-engine visibility — traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and which pages they cite — from actual GA4 referral data, not prompt sampling. Use when asked "AI visibility", "GEO/AEO check", "do LLMs cite us", "traffic from ChatGPT", or "how do we show up in AI search".
why_zh: 它不采样、不猜提示词，直接读 GA4 的 referrer 和 landing page。
why_en: No sampling, no prompt guessing—it maps real AI-engine referrals to cited landing pages straight from GA4. Data is the ledger.
limit_zh: 只认 GA4 的 referral 数据，且站点得有真实 AI 流量才看得出东西；不含搜索排名、不含非引用的品牌提及。
limit_en: Only reads GA4 referral data; needs actual AI traffic to show anything. No rankings, no non-referral brand mentions, no channels outside GA4.
title_en: Read real GA4 referral data to see if ChatGPT actually.
